title: Vocal Fry: what it is, who does it, and why people hate it!
summary: Linguist Geoff Lindsey explores vocal fry: what it is, who uses it, how it relates to glottal stops and accents, and why some people dislike it.
why: HN points to it as an expert correction of myths about vocal fry, showing it is a normal speech pattern across groups.

quote.text: it's not just that. It's (also?) a normal speech pattern, used by different genders, ages, and social groups, in many languages.
